name: Fractera Memory
shortDescription: The deep memory of the node: say «remember» and it keeps a phrase, a photo, a PDF or a voice note; ask «remind me about» and it answers from what was said, with the date and how sure it is.
longDescription: The memory of one architect, on the node. A phrase in any language is parsed once by Claude (the owner's subscription) into facts, and laid into the node's data layer: one table of messages (the data element), a vector for search by meaning (the vectors element), a ready graph of who and what is connected in the memory's own space of the graph element, and whole things in the object storage. A question climbs from cheap to expensive: the table, the graph, the vectors, one model call at most — and the answer says the depth it reached and how sure it is. A comment on an answer is collected for the evolution loop. Turned off by default: the node's main agent turns it on for a memory task.
accepts: A phrase or a question in any language from the node's main agent or an element: POST /v1/remember, /v1/recall, /v1/feedback with the node key (X-Node-Key); files as multipart parts files with the JSON in the part payload.
returns: One object: text for the person, ids of the stored things, certainty (affirmative · presumed · depends), the depth reached and an answer_id to comment on.

reason.en: Turned on for a memory task: «remember» and «remind me about» — the main agent turns it on and off
reason.ru: Включается на задачу памяти: «запомни» и «напомни о» — его включает и выключает главный агент
